stems.label: Stems
stems.about: Splitting songs into voice, drums, bass and melody, which stem moves and the Studio need.

move.cut.label: Cut
move.cut.about: A clean cut onto the next song's downbeat.
move.cut.core: Every transition falls back to a cut when nothing else passes its checks.

move.bass_swap_blend.label: Blend
move.bass_swap_blend.about: Both songs play in time, and they trade the bass halfway.

move.vocal_ride.label: Vocal ride
move.vocal_ride.about: The next song's band comes in under the voice, before it starts singing.

move.filter_sweep.label: Filter sweep
move.filter_sweep.about: The song filters away upward as the next one opens up.

move.tempo_ramp.label: Tempo ramp
move.tempo_ramp.about: Both songs drift to a shared speed for a short overlap.

move.loop_room.label: Loop and blend
move.loop_room.about: When a song leaves no clean bars to blend over, its last clean phrase loops so the next song can still come in slowly. Off until it has been listened to.

move.tempo_bridge.label: Tempo bridge
move.tempo_bridge.about: Songs too far apart in tempo to blend: the first is stripped to its beat and walked to the next one's speed over sixteen bars, then the next comes in untouched. Off until it has been listened to.

move.echo_out.label: Echo out
move.echo_out.about: The last beat rings on as the next song lands under it.

move.delay_throw.label: Delay throw
move.delay_throw.about: The last word is thrown into a delay as the next song slams in.

move.reverb_wash.label: Reverb wash
move.reverb_wash.about: The song dissolves into a room as the next one arrives.

move.word_cut.label: Word cut
move.word_cut.about: One song sets a phrase up, and the next one sings it.

move.word_blend.label: Word blend
move.word_blend.about: A vocal ride that hands over on a phrase both songs share.

move.phrase_roll.label: Phrase roll
move.phrase_roll.about: A phrase repeats, faster and faster, into the next song singing it.

move.call_and_response.label: Call and response
move.call_and_response.about: The voices trade a phrase over the next song's band until it keeps it.

move.strip_and_land.label: Strip and land
move.strip_and_land.about: One song strips down to its melody, the next is teased, then its bass and drums land.

move.intertwined_stems.label: Intertwined stems
move.intertwined_stems.about: Drums, bass and harmony trade over sixteen bars, with the vocals taking turns.

render.repair.label: Second takes
render.repair.about: A transition that fails a check is tried again, or with another move, before you hear it.

render.spare_time.label: Spare-time transitions
render.spare_time.about: With nothing else to do, the best transitions across the library are tried out ahead of time.

render.one_engine.label: One engine for stem seams
render.one_engine.about: On: Studio shapes, strip and land and intertwined stems play through the same engine as every other transition, so the next song is nudged into the pocket, the beats are lined up on a second take, and the vocal check hears the separated voices; word and ride moves also lock half- and double-time songs to one pulse. Off: those seams mix their own stems as before, with none of that.

analysis.phrases.label: Phrase lines
analysis.phrases.about: Transitions land on 8-bar phrase lines instead of any 4-bar mark, the way a DJ counts a song.

analysis.vocal_sense.label: Hear the voices
analysis.vocal_sense.about: When a song has no synced lyrics, listen to its separated voice to tell when someone sings, so it can still earn long blends and clashing voices are caught.

planner.true_key.label: Heard harmony
planner.true_key.about: Key scoring also hears the measured chroma of the exact bars that will play together, not just the two key labels.

planner.arrival.label: Rolls land on arrivals
planner.arrival.about: A phrase roll promises a drop, so the next song has to arrive on one: a chorus coming in, or its energy stepping up.

planner.motivated_punctuation.label: Motivated punctuation
planner.motivated_punctuation.about: An echo, cut or wash needs an audible reason - a line just finished or the song's structure turned - or it scores far lower.

planner.energy_intent.label: No unintended drops
planner.energy_intent.about: A punchy move from a hot exit into a much colder landing is refused unless the landing is a chorus.

planner.rhythm_fit.label: One drummer
planner.rhythm_fit.about: When two songs' drum patterns fight (four on the floor over a broken beat, straight over swung), a blend keeps only one song's kick and hats at a time and hands them over on a phrase line. Off until it has been listened to.

planner.calibrated_gates.label: Gates from your ratings
planner.calibrated_gates.about: The planner's limits on tempo gap, key distance, beat grid and overlap length use the values `selecta calibrate --apply` fitted to your Good and Bad clicks, within safe bounds. Off: the hand-set limits. Off until the owner chooses to apply a fit.
